title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Mark 11: the young donkey and the entry into Jerusalem, the fig tree, the temple cleared of traders and the question about the baptism of John.

questions.text: What were the two disciples told they would find in the village?
questions.explanation: He told them they would find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat, and that they should untie him and bring him.

answers.text: A young donkey on which no one had sat
A room prepared for a meal
A fig tree full of leaves
A colt with its mother beside it

questions.text: What were they to say if anyone asked why they were untying it?
questions.explanation: He told them to say, "The Lord needs him," and that the owner would immediately send him back.

answers.text: "We will bring him back tonight"
"The Lord needs him"
"The Teacher has paid for him"
"Do not ask us anything"

questions.text: What did people spread on the way as he came?
questions.explanation: Many spread their garments on the way, and others cut down branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

answers.text: Grain gathered from the fields
Stones from the Mount of Olives
The nets of the fishermen of Galilee
Their garments and branches from the trees

questions.text: What did those who went in front and those who followed cry out?
questions.explanation: They cried out, "Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"

answers.text: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God!"
"The time is fulfilled, repent and believe!"
"Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"
"Peace be to the city of our father David!"

questions.text: What did he find on the fig tree that had leaves?
questions.explanation: He came to see if he might find anything on it, and he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

answers.text: A few unripe figs
Nothing but leaves
Figs ready to be eaten
Only dry branches

questions.text: What did Jesus overthrow in the temple?
questions.explanation: He began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

answers.text: The money changers' tables
The altar of sacrifice
The doors of the temple
The seats of the elders

questions.text: What did he say his house would be called?
questions.explanation: He taught, saying that it is written, "My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations," but they had made it a den of robbers.

answers.text: A house of sacrifice for Israel
A house of teaching for the scribes
A house of prayer for all the nations
A house of the covenant of Moses

questions.text: What did they see when they passed the fig tree in the morning?
questions.explanation: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

answers.text: It was full of ripe figs
It had been cut down
Its leaves had fallen off
It had withered away from the roots

questions.text: What did Jesus say to do whenever you stand praying?
questions.explanation: He said that whenever you stand praying, forgive if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father in heaven may also forgive your transgressions.

answers.text: Forgive if you have anything against anyone
Pray where no one can see you
Give what you have to the poor
Say nothing but what is written

questions.text: What did the chief priests, scribes and elders answer when Jesus asked whether the baptism of John was from heaven or from men?
questions.explanation: They reasoned among themselves because they feared the people, and answered Jesus, "We don't know."

answers.text: "It was from heaven."
"We don't know."
"It was from men."
"We will not answer you."
